description: Indicative price from the Arcus Spot Router for swapping one Robinhood Chain token into another, e.g. how much NVDA 100 USDG buys right now, with venue, route and fees. Indicative only: AIDEN does not execute trades.

amount.description: Amount of the sell token, in whole units (e.g. "100" for 100 USDG)

buy.description: Token to buy: symbol (NVDA) or contract address

sell.description: Token to sell: symbol or address (default USDG)

name: get_stock_token_price
title: Get Stock Token price
